items.title: Cricketers satisfied with BCB’s BPL explanation
items.summary: The much-awaited meeting between the Cricketers Welfare Association of Bangladesh (CWAB) and the Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) took place at the board premises yesterday, with cricketer Nasir Hossain saying afterwards that the players had been informed the Bangladesh Premier League (BPL) would not take place this season.

items.title: Tigresses begin Asia Cup quest
items.summary: Bangladesh women’s team will begin their Women’s T20 Asia Cup campaign against Indonesia in a Group B fixture at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium today.

items.title: Rubel, Ripon’s fight in vain as Bangladesh HP bow out of Top End T20
items.summary: Bangladesh High Performance (HP) squad’s brave fight with the ball went in vain as they suffered a one-wicket defeat to Victoria CA in the first semifinal to bow out of the Top End T20 tournament in Darwin on Sunday.

items.title: ‘I just kept playing and playing’
items.summary: On his first overseas tour, the 30-year-old has emerged as a standout performer, taking 20 wickets in six matches, including a five-wicket haul against NT Strike on Friday that helped secure the Bangladeshi side’s semifinal spot. Rubel recently spoke to The Daily Star’s Samsul Arefin Khan about his unlikely rise, his first overseas experience and his hopes of reaching the national team, and more.

items.title: Starc goes past Bumrah to top Test bowling rankings for the first time
items.summary: Mitchell Starc returned figures of 6 for 12 and 4 for 39 in Australia's innings win over Bangladesh in Mackay
